notes: MagicBoard is now honest about what's on screen: Wingman waits for the real login result and tells you the truth (logged in, still on the login page, or needs MFA) instead of assuming — and it recognizes a 404 / wrong page / access-denied and says so.
It opens the device's main GUI reliably instead of guessing a deep-link that could 404. Login filling is more robust for Catalyst Center's form.
